name: Ashitani Karin
source:
Class: Year 2, Lily Class

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Wisdom Lady." She is a genius who was born into the Ashitani family, which is known for producing many renowed scholars. Karin is an extremely proud girl who doesn't know how to speak formally and as such talks to both her peers and teachers in the same way. She hates men more than anything and is extremely prejudiced towards the opposite sex.

She rarely leaves her room and often spends time on the internet, surfing through social media and anonymous messaging boards. However, because of her short temper, she tends to get easily get trolled.

The two things she's not confident about are her height and boob size.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1292095]Getchu[/url]]
